svg.title: Shivaji M D, AI Solutions Engineer, Bengaluru
svg.desc: From connectors that sync to agents that act. Animated: ERP, CRM, ticketing, HR, commerce, logistics, voice and knowledge bubbles feed a glowing enterprise-context core; an agent below it fires actions: resolve case, re-book, notify.
svg.text: SHIVAJI M D · AI SOLUTIONS ENGINEER · BENGALURU
13 years in B2B SaaS. I take enterprise use cases from
CXO discovery to production AI agents: the context layer
first, then guarded multi-agent workflows on top.
